title: Find the possible x-values
text: Since ln(t) requires $$t>0$$, $$x=t^3$$ takes every positive value.

title: Check the ends
text: As $$x$$ approaches $$0$$ from the right, ln(x) goes to $$-\infty$$, so $$x=0$$ (the y-axis) is a vertical asymptote. As $$x$$ goes to $$\infty$$, ln(x) grows without bound, so there is no horizontal asymptote.
